evidence.title: El-Sayed apologizes for comments about an attack on a Michigan synagogue

occurrences.subject: Abdul El-Sayed

occurrences.checkable_against: Michigan Jewish Democratic Caucus statement or convention records on 2026-08-29
occurrences.quote_span: Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan, apologized to the state’s Jewish Democratic Caucus on Saturday for comments he made after an attack on a synagogue in March, which he tied to Israel’s actions in the Middle East.

occurrences.subject: Abdul El-Sayed

occurrences.checkable_against: El-Sayed's apology remarks at the 2026-08-29 Lansing party convention

occurrences.subject: Abdul El-Sayed

occurrences.checkable_against: El-Sayed public statements and records of his association with Hasan Piker and antisemitism allegations
occurrences.quote_span: He’s eager to push past a series of controversies involving allegations of antisemitism, including his association with controversial commentator Hasan Piker.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Abdul El-Sayed

occurrences.checkable_against: El-Sayed's remarks to reporters and video/transcript from the Lansing party convention
occurrences.quote_span: “My comments may have been misconstrued to justify something I did not mean to justify,” El-Sayed told reporters after he addressed the caucus at a party convention in Lansing.
occurrences.speaker: Abdul El-Sayed
occurrences.subject: Abdul El-Sayed

occurrences.checkable_against: El-Sayed's video response published after the March 2026 Temple Israel attack

occurrences.subject: Abdul El-Sayed

occurrences.checkable_against: El-Sayed's remarks at the 2026-08-29 Lansing party convention
occurrences.quote_span: “What I was trying to do was offer context for why it happened, but it wasn’t the time for context,” El-Sayed said on Saturday, “and you don’t ever want to trample somebody’s pain.”

occurrences.subject: Abdul El-Sayed
